title: Urban Oasis
description: Urban Oasis is a visionary sustainable lifestyle brand conceived to reconnect city dwellers with living greenery through smart indoor hydroponics, architectural planters, and ecological home goods. As urban density increases and metropolitan apartments become increasingly detached from nature, the brand introduces accessible, low-maintenance biological systems that transform concrete living quarters into thriving, air-purifying domestic sanctuaries. It reimagines contemporary urban living by bringing clean sustainable agriculture and lush botanical foliage straight into residential interiors.

The brand bridges the gap between high-efficiency automated cultivation technology and serene natural interior aesthetics, empowering city residents to grow fresh organic greens directly from their living room walls. By prioritizing recycled materials, closed-loop water conservation, and clean sculptural lines, Urban Oasis champions a mindful, eco-conscious philosophy tailored for modern architecture. It transforms everyday apartments into refreshing personal oases where humans, design, and vibrant botanical life coexist in complete harmony.
direction: Since Urban Oasis merges technology and ecology, the design language focuses on modern minimalism drawn from natural forms. The logo resembles a U shaped pot holding a pixel style palm tree, referencing the oasis itself. The mark is complex in concept yet simple in execution, which mirrors the brand's overall identity: the mix of simplicity, natural greenery, and neon color rendered in precise pixelated geometry is essentially what the brand is about.

Look closer at the silhouette and there's a smile hidden in the U shaped pot, and open arms formed by the leaves. Both were the original spark, the first idea that came to mind when reading the brief. Everything else in the branding stays deliberately simple. Even the billboard is designed on transparent glass so the trees behind it show through, letting the idea show its work rather than explain itself.
